title.en: An Act Restoring to the Public Domain Certain Lands in the Mountain Province Reserved therefrom for Public Purposes By Executive Order of the Governor-General Numbered Sixty-three, Series of Nineteen Hundred and Seven.

text.en:
All of the public lands heretofore reserved for the use of the Mountain Province by executive
order of main, the Governor-General Numbered Sixty-three and dated December nineteenth, nineteen hundred
and seven, are hereby restored to the public domain and reopened for settlement and sale in accordance with
the provisions of Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty-six, as amended, in a like manner and effect as if
no such reservation had been made.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 27, 1913.
